√kṛś 'be lean'
present: [4.] kṛ́śyati 
perfect: cakárśa 
[aorist: akṛśat karśiṣyati karśitā ]
verbal: kṛZita kṛśitvā karśitvā 
secondary: causative: karśáyati etc. V.+ 
derivatives: karśana V.+ kṛśá V.+ kráśīyas C.

√kṛṣ 'drag, plough'
present: [1.] kárṣati etc. V.+ kárṣate etc. B.+ -- [6.] kṛṣáti kṛṣáte etc. V.+ 
perfect: cakarṣa etc. cakarṣatus B.+ 
aorist: [3.] acīkṛṣam acakarṣat -- [4.] akārkṣīt akrākṣīt -- [7.] akṛkṣat etc. akṛkṣathās 
future: [1.] krakṣyánt krakṣye karkṣyati karṣiṣyánt -- [2.] karṣṭā kraṣṭā 
verbal: kṛṣṭá AV.+ kraṣṭum E.+ kṛṣṭvā́ B.+ -kṛṣya S.+ 
secondary: passive: kṛṣyáte etc. B.+ -- intensive: cárkṛṣati etc. carīkṛṣ- -- desiderative: cikṛkṣa- -- causative: karṣayati etc. E.+ 
derivatives: karṣa S.+ karṣaka E.+ karṣin -ṣí B.+ karṣū́ B.+ karṣaṇa E.+ karṣaṇīya C. kā́rṣi -ṣín B. kā́rṣman RV. kṛṣí V.+ kṛṣya S.+ kṛṣṭí V.+ kraṣṭavya C. -kraṣṭṛ C. 
It does not seem worth while to divide this root, evidently one, into two nearly related ones, as is often done.
